_meta.what_this_is: A personal-assistant memory where three facts have changed. Each topic has an OLD note (short, so it matches the query's key words most tightly) and a NEW note (fresh and correct, with the updated detail that slightly dilutes the match). One hub 'index' page links to everything, so its backlink count dwarfs any real note. Each query wants the NEW note. The fixture is built so relevance alone serves the stale note, recency rescues the fresh one, and an unnormalised importance term lets the hub drown every query.
_meta.results_are: A FIXTURE with hand-set ages and backlink counts standing in for file mtimes and a real link graph. Point the ranker at your own memory with real timestamps.
_meta.gold_fresh: the current, correct note the ranker should surface
